metadata.title: Country Music Album Cover with Jukebox Reflection

retrievalProfile.description: A low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat looking into a glowing jukebox with a recursive reflection effect and bold italicized typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up profile of a man wearing a light-colored cowboy hat and a patterned western shirt, leaning over a glowing jukebox. The jukebox screen reflects his face and shows a recursive image of the album cover itself. The lighting is dramatic, with the primary light source emanating from the jukebox, casting deep shadows on the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed downward toward the glowing jukebox
Recursive reflection of the subject within the jukebox screen
Bold red display text anchored to the top right corner
Contrast between the dark background and the bright internal jukebox light
coreInvariants: Light-colored felt cowboy hat with a wide brim
Dark floral or paisley patterned western shirt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing jukebox screen in the lower right quadrant acts as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the subject's gaze from the top left down to the jukebox, then up to the red typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper right and lower right corners emphasizes the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark greens from the shirt and background provide a moody base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and the light tan of the hat contrast against the dark environment.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red is used for the primary artist name to ensure immediate legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low-value backgrounds and high-value highlights from the jukebox glow.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earthy tones and primary red

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars or underlines integrated into the letterforms
Rounded terminals on specific characters like 'y' and 'g'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' in the top line features a long tail that forms a horizontal underline for the first word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using red for the primary name and white for the secondary title, both sharing an italic sans-serif DNA.
graphicDevices: Horizontal underline bar extending from typography
Small circular icon embedded within the text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the display text.
Matches the sturdy, classic sans-serif look of 90s country albums.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a cowboy hat and a dark floral western shirt, leaning over a glowing jukebox in a dark room. The jukebox screen should show a reflection of his face and a recursive image of the scene itself.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, right-aligned italic sans-serif text in the top right corner. Use red for the top two lines and white for the bottom three lines. Include a horizontal bar extending from the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing a cowboy hat?
Does the jukebox screen contain a reflection?
Is the primary text red and italicized?

adjustableVariables: Degree of italic slant in typography
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the recursive image in the jukebox is a generic version of the scene

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of red text against dark background

postGenerationChecks: Check for the recursive reflection in the jukebox
Verify the red underline graphic element
Ensure the subject's profile is sharp and well-lit by the jukebox
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in profile + internal light source (jukebox/screen) + recursive reflection + bold italic right-aligned display type.
